quarterly_data.quarter: Quantum Computing Inc press release: Quantum Computing Inc. Announces Dirac-3S, Scaling to (10-01-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: QCi announced Dirac-3S, the next generation of its Dirac-3 quantum optimization machine: configurations of up to 9,980 variables demonstrated with one Expansion Module (a 10x increase over its current 1,000-variable system), a compact 5U base system extendable with further Expansion Modules, on-premises or cloud deployment, and hardware, manufacturing and supply-chain changes to support increased production volumes. The first customer shipment is expected in November 2026 (headline: Q4 2026). In QCi's own Technical Review, Dirac-3S was the only evaluated solver to reach the optimal solution on all synthetic test instances of 2,000 to 9,980 variables (company benchmark).
quarterly_data.figure: up to 9,980 variables; first customer shipment expected in November 2026
